scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run astro:build && npm run search:index
scripts.build:test:astro: GHOST_SEARCH_CACHE_PATH=.cache/ghost-search/test-posts.json npm run search:fixture && DOWNLOADS_SOURCE=fixture GHOST_SEARCH_CACHE_PATH=.cache/ghost-search/test-posts.json npm run build
scripts.build:search:fresh: npm run search:refresh && npm run build
scripts.test:astro:smoke:public: npm run build:test:astro && PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test --config playwright.astro.config.ts
scripts.test:astro:search: GHOST_SEARCH_CACHE_PATH=.cache/ghost-search/test-posts.json npm run search:fixture && GHOST_SEARCH_CACHE_PATH=.cache/ghost-search/test-posts.json SEARCH_RANKING_FIXTURE=1 npm run search:index && SEARCH_FIXTURE_TEST=1 PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test tests/astro/search.spec.ts --config playwright.astro.config.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:astro:high-value: PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test tests/astro/high-value-responsive.spec.ts tests/astro/high-value-navigation.spec.ts tests/astro/high-value-webkit-mobile.spec.ts tests/astro/homepage-latest.spec.ts --config playwright.astro.config.ts
scripts.test:astro:standalone: npm run build && node scripts/astro/check-public-artifact.js dist --standalone
scripts.test:astro:copy-parity: npm run build:test:astro && PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test tests/astro/copy-parity.spec.ts tests/astro/copy-parity-guardrails.spec.ts --config playwright.astro.config.ts
scripts.test:astro:copy-parity:update: npm run build:test:astro && PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test tests/astro/copy-parity.spec.ts --config playwright.astro.config.ts --update-snapshots=all --update-source-method=overwrite
scripts.test:astro:smoke:update: npm run build:test:astro && PLAYWRIGHT_START_SERVER=1 playwright test --config playwright.astro.config.ts --grep-invert @copy-parity --update-snapshots
